metadata.description: A reference architecture for cloud web apps — hexagonal .NET services, React, Terraform on Azure Container Apps — and the Claude Code workflow that builds and ships it.

plugins.name: dotnet-architect
plugins.description: Backend layer of the cloudstack reference architecture — scaffolds and enforces hexagonal .NET services: CQRS commands and queries, domain entities, EF Core migrations, tests, and architecture review.

plugins.name: react-developer
plugins.description: Frontend layer of the cloudstack reference architecture — React + TypeScript feature modules, frontend conventions and security, Playwright smoke tests and screenshots, and frontend review.

plugins.name: cloud-infra
plugins.description: Cloud layer of the cloudstack reference architecture — Terraform/Terragrunt for Azure Container Apps (or AKS + Helm), with linting, trivy security scans, plan-before-apply, and infrastructure review.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: The workflow that ties the cloudstack reference architecture together — requirements, GitHub issues, branches, quality gates, parallel review agents, and pull requests, from idea to shippable change.
